title: Making industrial intelligence visible
description: A visual communication project for an industrial technology brand, translating complex product capabilities into accessible, engaging video content for professional audiences.
overview: A visual communication project for an industrial technology brand, translating complex product capabilities into accessible, engaging video content for professional audiences.
challenge: Industrial technology is easy to describe in a specification sheet and harder to make feel relevant. The film needed to explain product capabilities without oversimplifying them, and to hold attention in a professional audience context.
approach: The film was developed as visual communication: a clear narrative, controlled visuals and an edit that makes technical information easier to understand. Generative production was used where it served clarity; editorial discipline kept the story coherent.

pillars.title: Technology
pillars.body: Industrial product capabilities translated into an accessible visual language.

pillars.title: B2B storytelling
pillars.body: A professional audience addressed with clarity rather than spectacle.

pillars.title: Explainer
pillars.body: Structure, pacing and visuals built around understanding.

process.body: Understand the product, the audience and the capabilities the film needed to communicate.
Develop the structure, visual direction and supporting references.
Create and refine the visuals that carry the explanation.
Shape pacing, captions, sound and delivery masters.

beforeAfter.note: The grade is restrained and professional, keeping attention on clarity rather than effect.

title: Connecting people with everyday support
description: Brand and promotional video content for a Perth-based cleaning and care services platform, designed to communicate its service offering and make the customer journey easier to understand.
overview: Brand and promotional video content for a Perth-based cleaning and care services platform, designed to communicate its service offering and make the customer journey easier to understand.
challenge: The service needed to be explained quickly and clearly, without relying on price-led messaging or unsupported claims. The films had to make the offering and the customer journey easy to follow.
approach: The content was built around service clarity: a defined message, accessible visuals and an edit that leads the viewer from need to action. AI-assisted production supported the visual work while the editorial decisions stayed audience-led.

overview: Long-form historical storytelling combining AI-assisted visual reconstruction, narrative editing and audio to bring past events into an engaging digital viewing experience. The client channel identity remains confidential.

approach: The work combines research-led visual reconstruction, narrative editing and audio. Generated scenes are framed as interpretation, and the structure is built for clarity and viewer retention rather than spectacle.
